import os
folder='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485747/attempts/18dbe85446804b4a9d8265837008f502/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(folder,exist_ok=True)
p=folder+'/task-b1235964.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # Periodically extend each colored motif through its surrounding zero rectangle.
    for color in (1, 4, 3):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        # Select the containing contiguous zero panel around the motif.
        top, bottom, left, right = r0, r1, c0, c1
        while top > 0 and all(v != 8 for v in out[top-1][left:right+1]): top -= 1
        while bottom+1 < h and all(v != 8 for v in out[bottom+1][left:right+1]): bottom += 1
        while left > 0 and all(out[r][left-1] != 8 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): left -= 1
        while right+1 < w and all(out[r][right+1] != 8 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): right += 1
        # Period is the visible motif's bounding-box size; its phase is anchored at top-left.
        ph, pw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
        tile = [[out[r0+(r % ph)][c0+(c % pw)] for c in range(pw)] for r in range(ph)]
        for r in range(top,bottom+1):
            for c in range(left,right+1):
                out[r][c] = tile[(r-r0) % ph][(c-c0) % pw]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(p,os.path.getsize(p))
